findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: cheapest_fuel_along_route, get_style, submit_optimise_job · Private data: check_clearance_on_route, check_style_contrast, create_style, get_style, get_usage, list_place_categories, match_trace, route, search_along_route, submit_optimise_job · Public sink: list_place_categories, optimise_routes, replan_routes, set_layer_paint, set_palette, submit_integration_retro, submit_optimise_job · Destructive: cluster, geocode, order_stops, plan_day, plan_ev_route, verify_places.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: cheapest_fuel_along_route, get_style, submit_optimise_job · Private data: check_clearance_on_route, check_style_contrast, create_style, get_style, get_usage, list_place_categories, match_trace, route, search_along_route, submit_optimise_job · Public sink: list_place_categories, optimise_routes, replan_routes, set_layer_paint, set_palette, submit_integration_retro, submit_optimise_job · Destructive: cluster, geocode, order_stops, plan_day, plan_ev_route, verify_places

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
